page.heading: Integrations
page.subtitle: Connect your tools: {{brand}} reads what you already have and acts where you work.

mcp.name: AI assistant
mcp.description: Query your accounts from your AI assistant. Connecting and revoking happen on its own screen.

error.title: The integrations list could not be loaded
error.body: Nothing can be concluded about your tools: the read failed, not the connections.

testHint: I run a real read, changing nothing. You will see exactly what I get back.
diagnosticFailed: The diagnostic itself did not complete. Try again in a moment.
latencyDeclared: Latency declared by the provider: {{value}} (as of {{when}})
latencyMeasured: Latency measured by {{brand}}: {{value}} (measured over {{days}} days, {{count}} synchronizations, as of {{when}})
betaGeneric: This tool is in beta at the provider.
neverDoesTitle: What I will never do with this tool:

errorCodes.scope_missing: I am not allowed to look
errorCodes.provider_api_disabled: access is switched off on the provider side

preConsentTitle: Before you continue, here is what I will be able to do:
preConsentScopeLimited: Nothing else is read or changed: only the capabilities listed above are used.
preConsentNever: I will never delete anything, and never send a message without your click. You can revoke this access at any time.
benefitsTitle: What this connected tool allows me to do:

derivedCapabilities.detect_conflicts: Spot clashes between your meetings — the calculation is mine, the tool only lists
derivedCapabilities.free_slots: Find your free slots, so you can offer a time that holds

toolActions.add_lead_to_campaign: Add a contact to one of your existing sequences, after your click
toolActions.create_draft: Prepare a draft — never send it for you
toolActions.create_event: Book a meeting, after your click
toolActions.create_mission: Create a mission in your ERP, once a second manager approves
toolActions.export_contact: Push a contact to this tool
toolActions.import_contacts: Bring in the contacts already there
toolActions.list_campaigns: Read your campaigns to pick where to add
toolActions.lookup_company: Look a company up in the registry
toolActions.read_emails: Read your exchanges to prepare a follow-up
toolActions.read_lead_statuses: Read back what happened (sent, opened, replied)
toolActions.read_pages: Read a page from your notes space
toolActions.send_email: Send a message, after your click
toolActions.send_message: Send a message, after your click
toolActions.send_notification: Alert you in your team channel
toolActions.send_to_signature: Send a document out for signature, after your click
toolActions.log_call: Add a call summary to a contact record in your ERP, once a second manager approves
toolActions.update_need_status: Change the status of a need in your ERP, once a second manager approves
toolActions.update_tjm: Update the day rate of a mission, once a second manager approves

importEntry.title: Already have files or a CRM?
importEntry.subtitle: Import your files (accounts, contacts, history) before starting from scratch. A connected CRM is imported by itself: its progress is on its card.

grid.title: Your tools, the same file
grid.subtitle: Choose what comes from each tool, review the changes, find their outcome.

guide.title: How to work here
guide.heading: Know what a tool lets you read or prepare
guide.intro: Each connector says what it reads, what it prepares and what waits for your validation.
guide.step2: Tell reading, preparing and writing apart.
guide.step3: Review the changes before they enter a file.
guide.keep: No tool shares your data with another firm. Everything is optional.

pointers.mcp: AI assistants and API keys are set up in Tools › Assistant access / MCP.

drawer.readScopeBody: Limited to the workspace and the allowed objects. No data shared between firms.
drawer.noDuplicateBody: External identity kept; a simultaneous change is left for you to arbitrate.
drawer.writesReviewedBody: Preview of the changes and validation. No success without the tool’s answer.

review.intro: Compare the information before updating a record. No blind “Approve all”.
review.unavailable: Read status unavailable — reading your tools failed, try again in a moment.
review.empty: Nothing to review: no difference between {{brand}} and your tools.
review.lockNote: Your correction is kept until you choose the other value.
review.failed: The choices could not be applied.
review.demoPreview: Preview: in the demo room, nothing is written.

history.intro: The operations actually made with your tools, and the result the tool reported.
history.empty: No operation yet: the history fills as soon as you read from or write to a connected tool.

history.intro: The operations actually carried out with your tools, and the result the tool reported.
history.failed: I couldn’t read your tools’ history.
history.empty: No synchronisation has been run yet with your connected tools.
history.emptyNoTool: No connected tool: the history appears from the first synchronisation.
